operations.description:
This API operation allows temporary guests to register by creating a new guest account in the system. The operation is public and does not require prior authentication. It creates a new record in the 'todo_app_guests' table, initializing fields to represent a guest user with a limited lifetime. It issues an initial JWT access token and refresh token for session management.

Security considerations include ensuring that this is a minimal access account and that tokens are generated according to system security policies. This operation is the entry point for unauthenticated users who want to interact with the system as guests.

The creation process involves persisting guest user data with appropriate default and timestamp fields as defined in the database schema.

Implementers should ensure adherence to token expiration and renewal policies consistent with guest sessions.

This API works in conjunction with the refresh token operation to maintain guest session continuity.

responseBody.description: Authorized guest session and tokens

operations.name: join

operations.description:
This API operation refreshes JWT tokens for an existing guest user session. It requires a valid refresh token to be presented and validates the token against stored values in the 'todo_app_guests' table or associated token management tables.

The operation issues new access and refresh tokens if the presented refresh token is valid and not expired. This enables seamless session continuation for guest users without requiring re-registration.

Security considerations include validating token integrity and revocation status. The operation contributes to robust guest session management while maintaining minimal access privileges.

Implementers must ensure that refresh tokens have limited lifetimes and are rotated accordingly.

This refresh operation complements the initial join operation and together they provide a complete guest authentication lifecycle.

responseBody.description: New authorized guest tokens

operations.description:
This operation enables new users to register an account with the todoApp system. It accepts necessary user details and securely stores user credentials including password hash in the todo_app_users table. Upon successful registration, the system issues initial JWT access and refresh tokens encapsulated in the IAuthorized interface for user actor.

The registration workflow validates uniqueness constraints on username or email fields. It integrates with related secure token mechanisms to ensure account security and readiness for subsequent login operations.

User actor access is public and does not require authentication. This is the entry point for new user onboarding.

Security considerations include input validation, secure password storage, and protection against registration abuse.

This operation complements login and refresh token management endpoints, providing the essential registration function required for member users.

responseBody.description: Authorization details including JWT tokens and user profile data.

operations.description:
The login operation authenticates a registered user by validating provided credentials against stored hashed password in the todo_app_users table. Successful authentication returns JWT access and refresh tokens within the ITodoAppUser.IAuthorized response structure.

This operation requires public access as it is the gateway to authenticated sessions for user actor.

It verifies credential correctness securely and supports scenarios such as locked or disabled accounts through appropriate error responses.

Integration with token refresh and password reset workflows ensure cohesive authentication lifecycle management.

Security controls include rate limiting, secure password comparison, and protection against brute force attacks, ensuring safe authentication access.

It ensures continuous secure access without requiring users to repeatedly log in. Refresh tokens are validated for expiration and integrity before issuing new access tokens.

This endpoint requires a valid refresh token to be submitted securely and is accessible to authenticated user actor sessions.

Security measures include refresh token revocation upon logout or suspicious activity.

This operation integrates with login and join endpoints to maintain seamless token lifecycle management for user authentication.

ITodoAppGuest.IJoin.description: Request DTO for guest user registration allowing creation of a temporary guest account in the todo application. This schema captures guest-provided identification (email) and connection context metadata (ip, href, referrer) essential for audit and security logging. The unique guest identifier and session management fields are maintained internally and are not part of this request. Excludes actor identity fields to ensure security compliance.

email.description: Email address submitted by the guest user for identification purposes. Must follow valid email formatting as per RFC 5322.

ip.description: Optional IP address of the guest user's connection origin. This provides additional security and audit information. Can be null if unknown or not supplied.

href.description: The URL of the current page where the guest user initiates the join request. Required for session context establishment and security analysis.

referrer.description: The URL of the referring page leading to the join request. Empty string if the guest accessed the request page directly. Used for analytics and security tracking.

ITodoAppUser.IAuthorized.description:
Represents the authorization result for a member user after successful authentication, including the unique user ID from the todo_app_users table and the issued JWT tokens encapsulated within the token property referencing IAuthorizationToken.

This schema forms the basis for secure member session handling and token-based authentication in the todoApp system, ensuring sensitive information like passwords are excluded and only safe authorization data is exposed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user, representing the primary key in the todo_app_users table ensuring unambiguous user identity within the system.

email.description: User's email address used for authentication and notifications.

username.description: User's chosen unique username for display and login purposes.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the user account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp noting the last update made to the user account profile.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was soft-deleted. Null if active.

passwordHash.description: Indicates if the user's password has been hashed and stored securely in the system.

role.description: User role in the system defining permissions and access levels.

verified.description: Email verification status indicating whether the user's email is verified.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user logged in to the system.

ITodoAppRole.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new user role in the todoApp system. This schema maps to the todo_app_roles database table and defines the mandatory and optional fields needed to create a new role.

Only the role name and optional descriptive information are supplied by the client. The identity of the acting user is obtained from the authenticated session and is not part of the request body.

This ensures secure and consistent role creation with proper permissions management.

name.description: Unique name of the role used as an identifier in the system. This field is required and must be unique across all roles.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the role outlining its purpose and responsibilities. Helps administrators understand role usage.

ITodoAppUserRole.description:
Represents the association of a user with a role in the todoApp system, mapped to the todo_app_user_roles database table. This entity controls user permissions by defining which roles are assigned to which users.

Each instance contains the user ID, role ID, and related metadata such as creation and update timestamps. This structure supports many-to-many relationships between users and roles, enabling flexible access control management.

Used in API operations for assigning roles to users (creation) and modifying those assignments (update).

id.description: Unique identifier for the user-role association record.

user.description: The user associated with this role. Joined via todo_app_user_roles.todo_app_user_id FK to todo_app_users table.

role.description: The role assigned to the user. Joined via todo_app_user_roles.todo_app_role_id FK to todo_app_roles table.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this user-role association was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last update time of this user-role association.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.description: User password reset request entity representing a single password reset request issued to a user, stored in the todo_app_user_password_resets table. This includes details such as token, expiration, and request time to facilitate secure password reset workflows within the todoApp system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the password reset request, generated by the system.

todo_app_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who requested the password reset. Corresponds to the user in the todo_app_users table.

token.description: Secure reset token generated for the password reset request. Used to validate password reset submissions.

expires_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the reset token expires. Null if the token does not expire.

requested_at.description: Timestamp recording when the reset token was requested. Null if unset.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was last updated.

ITodoAppTodoItem.description: ITodoAppTodoItem represents a single todo list item that belongs to a user in the todoApp system. It includes task details such as title, description, status, and timestamps for creation, update, and deletion. The item is linked to its owning user via todo_app_user_id foreign key, ensuring user-specific data management and privacy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the todo item assigned by the system.

todoAppUserId.description: Identifier of the user who owns this todo item. This is set from the authentication context and not supplied in request bodies.

title.description: Brief title describing the todo task.

description.description: Optional detailed description providing more information about the todo item. Nullable if not provided.

status.description: Indicates whether the todo item has been marked as complete by the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp marking when the todo item was initially created in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the todo item. This can be null if there are no updates.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the todo item was soft deleted. Null if the item is active.

user.description: Summary information of the user who owns this todo item.

auditLogs.description: Audit logs capturing change history for this todo item.

ITodoAppRole.description:
The ITodoAppRole entity represents a user role in the todoApp system, stored in the todo_app_roles database table. Each role defines permissions, access levels, and descriptive metadata for user authorization and access control management within the application.

This type includes all essential fields to uniquely identify and describe a role, including its human-readable name and optional descriptive text that explains the role’s purpose and scope.

The schema adheres to security best practices by excluding any sensitive or system-managed information, ensuring safe transmission between the client and server. It supports usage as a response in role retrieval operations.

This type maps directly to the todo_app_roles database table, guaranteeing consistency between the API and database representations.

id.description: Primary key UUID uniquely identifying this role record in the database.

name.description: Human-readable name of the role that describes its purpose and usage in the system.

description.description: Optional detailed description providing additional context about the role, its permissions, and intended users.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when this role was created in the system for auditing and record-keeping purposes.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last time this role record was updated, supporting synchronization and version control.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this role was soft deleted, if applicable, null otherwise.

userRoles.description: List of user-role assignments associated with this role, describing which users have been assigned this role.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new todo_app user email verification record.

Contains properties to submit a new email verification token, its expiration and verification status. User association is derived from authenticated context and must not be submitted by client.

This schema maps directly to the todo_app_user_email_verifications database table.

token.description: The email verification token string generated for the user's verification process.

token_expired_at.description: The expiration timestamp indicating when the verification token expires and becomes invalid.

verified_at.description: The timestamp when the user's email was verified using this token. Null if not verified yet.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the verification record was created. Typically set by the system and nullable during creation.

deleted_at.description: The timestamp when the verification record was deleted or invalidated. Null if active.

ITodoAppUser.IRefresh.description: Request DTO for refreshing JWT tokens for authenticated users to obtain new access tokens. Represents the refresh token payload linked to user sessions in the todo_app_refresh_tokens table.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token string issued to a user session to securely refresh and renew JWT access tokens. This token is validated for expiration and authenticity during token refresh operations.

ITodoAppGuest.IAuthorized.description:
Authorized guest session response payload representing a temporary guest user in the todo application.

This schema includes the unique guest identifier and the JWT authorization token issued upon successful guest registration or token refresh. It is used to authenticate and authorize guest users with limited lifetime and minimal privileges.

The guest session is transient and managed with strict security policies to ensure safe access.

Used in responses for endpoints '/todoApp/auth/guest/join' and '/todoApp/auth/guest/refresh'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user in the system. Corresponds to the primary key in the 'todo_app_guests' database table and used to track the guest session lifecycle.

ITodoAppUserRole.IUpdate.description: Update request DTO for the todoApp user role linkage. Allows partial updates to fields associating users and roles, excluding immutable system-generated timestamps. Actor IDs are from authentication context and not included in body. All fields are optional to support partial updates.

todoAppUserId.description: Foreign key linking to the user in todo_app_users. Specifies which user is associated with this role assignment.

todoAppRoleId.description: Foreign key linking to the role in todo_app_roles. Specifies which role is assigned to the user.

ITodoAppTodoItem.IUpdate.description: Partial update DTO for todo items in the todoApp system. Allows modification of title, description, and status fields for the authenticated user's todo items. Ownership and system-managed fields are excluded as they are handled by the backend.

title.description: The title or summary of the todo item, summarizing the task to be completed.

description.description: Detailed description of the todo item; nullable to allow clearing the description.

status.description: Current status of the todo item, indicating its progress or state.

ITodoAppUserRole.ICreate.description: Request DTO for assigning one or more roles to users in the todoApp system. Represents the many-to-many user-role relationship targeting the todo_app_user_roles table. User identity is inferred from the authenticated session and thus excluded from the request body.

todo_app_user_id.description: Foreign key referencing the unique identifier of a user. Specifies which user is assigned the role(s).

todo_app_role_id.description: Foreign key referencing the unique identifier of a role. Specifies the role assigned to the user.

email.description: The email address of the user attempting to log in. This must be a valid email associated with a registered account in the todo app system.

password.description: The plain text password provided by the user for authentication. It is securely compared against the stored hashed password during login processing.

ITodoAppUser.ILogin.description: Request DTO for user login operation in the todoApp system. Contains the credentials necessary for authenticating the user.

ITodoAppUserRole.ISummary.description:
Summary of user role assignment within todoApp system, reflecting the association between users and their roles. This DTO is optimized for listing use cases and provides identifier and relational context without exposing sensitive information.

This schema maps directly to the todo_app_user_roles database table and includes references to summarized user and role entities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user role record.

user.description: Summary of the user assigned with the role.

role.description: Summary of the role assigned to the user.

ITodoAppGuest.IRefresh.description: Request DTO for refreshing JWT tokens for a guest user session. Contains the valid refresh token string used by the guest to request new access and refresh tokens during authentication refresh operations.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token string provided by the guest client to perform a secure token refresh. This token must be valid, not expired, and corresponds to a session managed via related guest session or access token records.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user email verification record in the todo_app_user_email_verifications table.

token.description: Email verification token string used for confirmation purposes.

token_expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token. Null if token has no expiration or is already expired.

verified_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the email verification record was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the email verification record was soft deleted. Null if active.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating existing user email verification record in todo_app_user_email_verifications table. All properties are optional to allow partial updates. The 'id' is provided as the path parameter and not part of the request body. The user_id is managed by backend authentication context and must not be included for update.

ITodoAppTodoItem.ICreate.description: Request DTO schema for creating a todo item in the todo_app_todo_items table. Excludes user ID as it is derived from the authentication context. Includes the todo item title (required), optional description, and optional status fields.

title.description: Title of the todo item representing the core task to be completed. This field is required to provide a succinct, user-friendly name for the todo entry.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the todo item providing additional context or information about the task, if necessary.

status.description: Indicates the current status of the todo item, such as 'pending' or 'completed'. This field is optional and defaults to its initial state if not specified.

ITodoAppUser.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing user in the todoApp system.

Allows partial updates of user properties by the authenticated user while excluding system-managed and identity fields to ensure security and data integrity.

email.description: The user's email address used for login and communications. Must be unique and follow the standard email format.

username.description: The username chosen by the user for login and identification purposes in the system.

password.description: The user's account password in plain text. The backend securely hashes this password and stores it in the database's 'password_hash' column. Clients should only send plain passwords here for update.

ITodoAppRole.IRequest.description: Request DTO for filtering and paginating user roles in the todoApp system. All properties are optional to allow flexible search and sorting criteria in the role listing endpoint.

searchTerm.description: Optional search term to filter roles by matching name or description fields.

roleName.description: Optional exact role name filter to narrow down results to specific roles.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be 1 or greater.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page for paginated results. Must be 1 or greater.

sortBy.description: Optional field name to sort the list of roles by. For example, 'name' or 'createdAt'.

sortOrder.description: Sort order direction, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').

ITodoAppTodoItemAuditLog.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new audit log entry related to a user's todo item in the todoApp system.

This DTO includes the action that describes the specific event or change being logged in the audit trail. It excludes user and todo item identifiers because those are supplied as path parameters and through authentication context.

The audit log captures user interactions with todo items for accountability and history tracking.

action.description: Description of the action performed on the todo item, capturing what event occurred for audit purposes.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.IRequest.description: Request schema for password reset operation that allows users to submit a valid reset token and a new plain text password. This schema maps to the 'todo_app_user_password_resets' table capturing the token but excludes system-managed and user context fields for security. The password field is an input-only field not mapped to a database column.

token.description: Unique reset token string issued to a user to authorize password reset. This must be valid and unexpired.

password.description: New plain text password provided by the user. The backend securely hashes this password upon processing. This field has no corresponding database column mapping, hence x-autobe-database-schema-member is null.

ITodoAppRole.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a user role in the todoApp system.

This summary includes essential identifiers and descriptive fields of the role as defined in the todo_app_roles database table.

Used in list operations and role references to provide concise role data without exposing detailed permissions or relations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the role. This serves as the primary key in the todo_app_roles table and is used to uniquely identify each user role within the system.

name.description: The name of the role, describing its purpose or designation within the system. Used in UIs and administrative contexts to identify the role.

description.description: A textual description providing additional details about what the role entails or its scope of permissions. This helps administrators and users understand the function of the role.

ITodoAppRole.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating an existing user role entity in the todo_app_roles table of the todoApp system. Allows optionally modifying role name and description fields while excluding immutable identifiers and system-managed fields.

name.description: Readable name of the user role, used for display purposes in administrative interfaces.

description.description: Detailed text describing the purpose, permissions, and scope of this user role. Useful for administrators.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the role record was created. This field is system-managed and should not be modified by API clients.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the role record. This field is system-managed and typically managed by the backend system.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the role record was soft-deleted. Null if active. Soft deletion supports reversible disabling of roles.

ITodoAppUserRole.IRequest.description:
Request parameter type for filtering and paginating todoApp user roles in the todoApp system.

This type represents the search criteria, sorting, and pagination options submitted by clients when retrieving filtered user role assignments. It does not map directly to a specific database table, but rather serves as a compositional input for query construction.

Properties include optional filters to refine the role search and control pagination behavior.

Used exclusively as input in the PATCH /todoApp/user/users/roles API operation by authorized users with 'user' role.

search.description:
Search keyword applied to user role properties to filter results for relevant roles matching the search terms.

This filter supports partial matches and is optional for clients wanting to narrow down results based on textual criteria.

role_id.description:
Unique identifier of the role to filter user roles matching this specific role.

This allows restricting the search results to users assigned this particular role. This field supports exact match and is optional.

user_id.description:
Unique identifier of the user to filter roles assigned only to this user.

This filter restricts results to roles assigned to the specified user id and is optional.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results. Starts from 1.

Used to control which slice of the filtered role list is returned in the response.

Optional, defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description:
Maximum number of user role items to return per page.

Controls the page size of paginated results with an upper limit to protect system performance.

Optional with default value typically set by the service.

oneOf.description:
Field by which to sort the filtered user role results.

Allowed values include role_name for alphabetical ordering or created_at for chronological ordering.

Optional. Defaults to sorting by created_at if omitted.

Field by which to sort the filtered user role results.

Allowed values include role_name for alphabetical ordering or created_at for chronological ordering.

Optional. Defaults to sorting by created_at if omitted.

sort_by.description:
Field by which to sort the filtered user role results.

Allowed values include role_name for alphabetical ordering or created_at for chronological ordering.

Optional. Defaults to sorting by created_at if omitted.

oneOf.description:
Sort order direction for the results.

Ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order can be specified.

Optional, default is ascending if omitted.

Sort order direction for the results.

Ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order can be specified.

Optional, default is ascending if omitted.

sort_order.description:
Sort order direction for the results.

Ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order can be specified.

Optional, default is ascending if omitted.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new user password reset request in the todoApp system. This object includes only the fields required to initiate the reset process for the authenticated user. User identification is handled via authentication tokens, so user ID fields are omitted from this request schema.

token.description: Unique token used to authenticate the password reset request. This token is securely generated and sent to the user via email for password recovery.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp specifying the validity period of the password reset token. After this time, the token becomes invalid. Must be in ISO 8601 date-time format.

requested_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the password reset request was initiated. Null if the request has not yet been made. Must use ISO 8601 date-time format.

ITodoAppTodoItemAuditLog.description:
Audit log entity representing a change event related to a todo item for a specific user.

This entity records detailed audit information including which user performed what action on which todo item, when it occurred, and additional contextual details.

It supports tracking modifications, creations, and deletions of todo items for audit and compliance purposes within the todoApp system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

user.description: User who owns the todo item associated with this audit log entry. Transformed from todo_app_user_id FK field to referenced object for full user context.

todoItem.description: The todo item this audit log pertains to. Transformed from todo_app_todo_item_id FK field to referenced object for full todo item context.

action.description: The specific action that triggered this audit log entry, such as creation, modification, or deletion of a todo item.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated, null if never updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the audit log entry was deleted, null if not deleted.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.IRequest.description: Request DTO for partial update of a user's email verification information within todoApp. Allows submitting new token or updating token expiration and verification timestamp. Excludes user identity fields as those are injected from authenticated session context.

id.description: Unique identifier of the email verification record. Provided if needed to identify the record for update.

token.description: Verification token sent to the user's email address used to confirm ownership and validate the email.

token_expired_at.description: Expiration datetime of the verification token. The token becomes invalid after this timestamp, requiring a new token for verification attempts.

verified_at.description: Datetime when the email address was successfully verified. Null indicates that verification has not yet been completed.

token.description: Password reset token used to authorize the reset operation. Must be a securely generated string and can be updated to invalidate prior tokens.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the reset token expires. Null if token does not expire. Used to enforce token validity periods.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset was requested by the user. Null if unknown. Helps in auditing and expiry calculations.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the reset request was deleted or invalidated. Null if active. Used for soft delete handling.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating a user password reset request in the todoApp system. All fields are optional to allow partial updates. User authentication injects identity context; thus, fields like user_id are excluded from client input to ensure security.

ITodoAppUser.description:
User entity representing a registered user in the todoApp system. Provides comprehensive details relevant for user profile, authentication status, role assignments, and activity tracking.

This schema excludes sensitive authentication credentials such as password hashes and tokens to maintain security best practices. It includes fields for user identification, email, username, account timestamps, and relations to roles, sessions, and associated entities.

Used in responses to user-related API operations for full user profile data access.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user in UUID format.

email.description: User's email address used for authentication and notifications.

username.description: User's chosen unique username for display and login purposes.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the user account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp noting the last update made to the user account profile.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was soft-deleted. Null if active.

passwordHash.description: Indicates if the user's password has been hashed and stored securely in the system.

role.description: User role in the system defining permissions and access levels.

verified.description: Email verification status indicating whether the user's email is verified.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the last time the user logged in to the system.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.description:
User email verification entity represents an email verification request and its status within the todoApp. It maintains token details, expiration, verification status, user association, and audit timestamps to securely manage email confirmation processes.

This entity is mapped to the 'todo_app_user_email_verifications' database table, reflecting all its columns with accurate types and constraints. It is central to user authentication workflows ensuring only verified emails are linked to user accounts.

Relations:
- user: Reference to the user who owns this verification record, transformed in responses to ITodoAppUser.ISummary for secure representation.

Security:
- Request DTOs exclude all actor identification fields such as user_id to prevent client-side manipulation.
- Response DTOs exclude sensitive token usage data beyond necessary verification details.

All datetime fields support nullability where defined in the database, ensuring accurate reflection of verification lifecycle states.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user email verification record.

user.description: Reference to the user associated with this email verification record.

token.description: Verification token sent to the user's email address for confirmation purposes.

token_expired_at.description: The timestamp when the verification token expires. Null if not applicable or indefinite.

verified_at.description: The timestamp when the email address was successfully verified. Null if verification not completed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this verification record was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking logical deletion of the record. Null if active.

ITodoAppUser.IJoin.description:
Request DTO for member user registration in the todoApp system.

Represents the payload data needed for a guest to create a new member account. The schema excludes identity and system-managed fields and includes session context for auditing connection information.

This DTO directly maps to the `todo_app_users` database table, with sensitive fields handled securely by the backend.

username.description: Unique username chosen by the member for login and identification within the system. Must be unique and meet validation constraints.

email.description: Member's email address used for account registration, login, and communications. Must be a valid email format.

password.description: Plain text password provided by the user during registration. The backend hashes and stores the password securely in the database.

href.description: The URL of the page from which the registration request originated. Used for session auditing and security monitoring. This field is required.

referrer.description: The URL of the referring page leading the user to the registration page. Used for session auditing and security analysis. This field is required.

access.description:
JWT access token for authenticated requests.

This token should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent
authenticated API requests as `Bearer {token}`.

refresh.description:
Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

This token can be used to request new access tokens when the current access
token expires, extending the user's session.

expired_at.description:
Access token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the access token will expire and
can no longer be used for authentication.

refreshable_until.description:
Refresh token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating the latest time until which the
refresh token can be used to obtain new access tokens.

ITodoAppAccessToken.description:
Authorization token response structure.

This interface defines the structure of the authorization token response
returned after successful user authentication. It contains both access and
refresh tokens along with their expiration information.

This token structure is automatically included in API schemas when the system
detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides
a standard format for JWT-based authentication across the generated backend
applications.

ITodoAppUser.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a registered user in the todoApp system. It contains essential identification information such as unique identifier and username, excluding sensitive credentials or detailed profile information. This schema maps directly to the todo_app_users database table and is used throughout the API to refer to users in a secure and concise manner.

ITodoAppTodoItem.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for a todo item in the todoApp user todo list.

Provides the essential identification properties and completion status of the todo item. Used primarily in listings, audit logs, and other scenarios where full detail is unnecessary.

Excludes heavy or sensitive information to preserve performance and security integrity.
